parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more precise personalization (cites specific income, expenses, savings rate, holding overlap details) and more actionable specifics (exact tickers, dollar amounts, glide path), while better aligning risk_level tags with the user's aggressive tolerance. System B offers a valuable tax-advantaged accounts recommendation but includes weaker risk alignment (labeling aggressive-appropriate recs as 'low' risk, and mislabeling crypto reduction as 'high' risk) and a nonsensical -3% allocation figure.
